decisions.why: LEGO "play | 放": 放 basically means "put"; it means "play" only with music/films. Its whole basket is about putting ("put it | 放它", "she put it there | 她放在那里了"…), so the English never says "play" and the learner is taught play = put. Proposed: re-cut to "play music | 放音乐" (the seed's own words), after a "music" LEGO, and rebuild the basket. A LEGO re-cut is Kai's call.
decisions.gloss: 放 fàng = put / (music) play
